info.name: Vidya Mission API
info.description:
Official Postman Collection for **Vidya Mission** — West Bengal Board Online Learning & Examination Platform.

### Environment Variables
- `base_url`: `http://localhost:8000/api`
- `token`: Bearer Sanctum Token (set automatically on Login/Register/Verify OTP)
- `admin_token`: Bearer Sanctum Token for Admin requests
- `teacher_token`: Bearer Sanctum Token for Teacher requests
